name: Kbd
summary: A keyboard key, or a combination of keys, shown inline in text.
description: Use it in help text, menus and shortcut lists. A combination nests the keys in an outer <kbd>, as HTML intends.

classes.name: v-kbd
classes.description: One key: a small keycap in the mono font with a thicker bottom edge.

classes.name: v-kbd-combo
classes.description: An outer <kbd> around several .v-kbd keys and the + between them.

a11y: <kbd> is read as plain text, so write the key names in full where symbols are ambiguous, or add an aria-label (e.g. "Up arrow").
Show the shortcut for the platform people are on (Ctrl or Cmd) when you know it.

examples.title: Keys and combinations
examples.html:
Open the command palette with Ctrl+K.

Save with Cmd+S, close with Esc.

Move between rows with ↑ ↓ and open one with Enter.
